name: io.github.chunge233/uxmio-image-mcp
title: UXMIO Image MCP Server
description: Zero-dependency MCP server & CLI for AI image generation and multi-image editing (GPT Image 2/2.5/2.6, Gemini 3.1 Flash / 3 Pro Image) via any OpenAI-compatible /v1/images API.

environmentVariables.name: UXMIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for api.uxmio.com or any OpenAI-compatible /v1/images provider

environmentVariables.name: UXMIO_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional custom OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: https://api.uxmio.com/v1)
